prior to completing [[Ruins of Morah]] | ingame name=The Ruptured Heart | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=439 }} [[The Ruptured Heart]] is the area of the Desolation where [[Abaddon]] was defeated in ancient times and banished to the [[Realm of Torment]]. The weakened boundary between the [[Tyria (world)|world of Tyria]] and the Realm of Torment has cracked and twisted the terrain, undermining the old city of [[Ruins of Morah (outpost)|Morah]], and creating ravines that travel outwards into other parts of [[the Desolation]]. At the center of this ruined landscape is the crater formed when Abaddon was cast out of Tyria. ==Getting there== Completion of the [[Ruins of Morah]] mission will have your party ending up in the [[Gate of Torment]]. From there, entering the [[Vortex]] will bring your party to [[the Mouth of Torment]]. Exit that outpost via one of its two exits to arrive in this area. Alternatively, travel north from the [[Ruins of Morah (outpost)|Ruins of Morah outpost]].
